messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed console sampling and route attribution jumpy after last SDK init reorder in py/ts/go clients. Traces show sampling flag set after routemeta is emitted so console buckets are off.
liam: ugh. is this the change where init() became lazy? :thinking_face:
jess: yes, introduced lazy init to avoid cold-start cost. but it defers telemetry handshake until first request.
maya: example in py (we see same pattern in ts/go):
```
# python
client = RedwoodClient()  # lazy
client.generate(...)  # triggers init & telemetry
```
anita: so routemeta packets sometimes go out with default sampling 0.0 and later ones 1.0 -> console splits them across two charts.
maya: exact. dashboard shows two nearly-identical routes as separate lines, making quota alerts noisy.
liam: short term workaround — call client._ensure_init() or do an explicit client.init() on app startup.
jess: agreed. we should expose a public client.init() in all three libs (py/ts/go) rather than forcing people to call private APIs.
eng-platform: two implementation options: 1) patch runtime to send routemeta only after handshake completes, or 2) buffer routemeta until init finishes. Which is lower risk?
anita: buffering seems safer (no perf regression) — hold first routemeta per process and flush post-handshake.
maya: can we toggle buffering via env var so we can roll back quickly? :thumbsup:
eng-platform: yes — add REDWOOD_BUFFER_ROUTEMETA=true with default false for canary. then flip for prod after 24h if signals look good.
liam: i'll draft tiny SDK PRs for python + typescript that add client.init() and respect the env buffer. assign to @jess for review.
jess: will also add a console notice explaining the temporary split and link to workaround docs.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: create feature flag, update console docs, add telemetry unit test, coordinate canary across regions.
maya: also add a short telemetry e2e that simulates delayed init and asserts routemeta coalescing.
eng-platform: good call. timeline: liam to open SDK PRs EOD, eng-platform to prototype buffer in runtime tomorrow morning, canary roll by Friday.
liam: PR placeholders: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/XXXX (py), https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/YYYY (ts) — will update links.
jess: ping me once PRs ready. i'll add migration note to changelogs and post a short blurb in #general to warn customers using self-managed SDKs.
maya: thanks everyone. will follow-up with console diffs for the temporary split display (map old ids -> new ids in UI for a week).
